initialize_config: initialize the tradingagents config with default values from default_config.DEFAULT_CONFIG
set_config: set custom config values by passing a dictionary to override default tradingagents config
get_config: get a copy of the current tradingagents configuration dictionary
build_config_get: build a script that retrieves the default tradingagents configuration using get_config
refactor_config_set: refactor the set_config function to validate config dictionary keys before updating
